required.name: arbiter.rejects-overlap
required.outcome: automatic acquisition cannot acquire while manual destructive work owns the arbiter

required.name: arbiter.releases-once
required.outcome: settlement callback releases exactly once and stale generations cannot release a newer owner

required.name: equipment.preserves-preview
required.outcome: a delayed authoritative profile event cannot overwrite an uncommitted local equip preview

required.name: equipment.bounds-retry
required.outcome: only confirmed idempotent failure retries and retry count is bounded

required.name: curio.rotation-waits
required.outcome: stale, mixed, or incomplete storefront boundaries remain nonterminal and cannot purchase

required.name: curio.purchase-revalidates
required.outcome: candidate identity and eligibility are revalidated before a purchase POST

required.name: curio.reads-cancel
required.outcome: leaving a context cancels owned read promises and late callbacks are inert

required.name: discard.keeps-ownership
required.outcome: manual and automatic destructive paths cannot overlap and ownership survives in-flight deletion

required.name: discard.fails-closed
required.outcome: missing protection or optional integration data aborts safely without destructive action

required.name: session.restores-owned-fields
required.outcome: teardown restores only fields still owned by BetterInventory

required.name: settings.audit-localization
required.outcome: active settings have authoritative metadata and localization IDs

required.name: customization.persistence-bounds
required.outcome: delegated and failed DMF saves have bounded, observable persistence outcomes
